content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To get into gardening, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sketch a layout for the garden beds (2 hours)
Step 2. Measure the dimensions of the backyard (1 hour)
Step 3. Apply organic mulch to the surface (3 hours)
Step 4. Install a basic drip irrigation system (6 hours)
Step 5. Research local hardiness zones (1 hour)
Step 6. Build raised wooden garden frames (5 hours)
Step 7. Mix compost into the topsoil (4 hours)
Step 8. Buy high-quality gardening gloves (30 minutes)
Step 9. Purchase a set of hand tools (1 hour)
Step 10. Visit a local nursery for advice (2 hours)
Step 11. Select a sunny location in the yard (30 minutes)
Step 12. Level the ground for the beds (4 hours)
Step 13. Label each section with plant markers (1 hour)
Step 14. Set up a rain barrel for water collection (2 hours)
Step 15. Stake tall vegetable plants (1 hour)
Step 16. Test the soil pH levels (2 days)
Step 17. Spread a thin layer of steer manure (3 hours)
Step 18. Order heirloom seeds online (1 hour)
Step 19. Buy a heavy-duty garden hose (20 minutes)
Step 20. Attend a weekend gardening workshop (2 days)
Step 21. Rent a rototiller from the hardware store (4 hours)
Step 22. Watch online tutorials on pruning (2 hours)
Step 23. Clear away large rocks and debris (3 hours)
Step 24. Buy bags of specialized potting mix (2 hours)
Step 25. Determine the water requirements for chosen plants (1 hour)
Step 26. Install a decorative garden fence (1 day)
Step 27. Design a vertical trellis for climbing vines (3 hours)
Step 28. Apply organic pest repellent (1 hour)
Step 29. Dig trenches for drainage (5 hours)
Step 30. Fill the beds with premium garden soil (6 hours)
Step 31. Buy a sturdy wheelbarrow (45 minutes)
Step 32. Organize a storage shed for tools (4 hours)
Step 33. Clear out existing weeds and grass (1 day)
Step 34. Mark the perimeter with spray paint (30 minutes)
Step 35. Transplant seedlings into the garden (4 hours)
Step 36. Add slow-release fertilizer granules (1 hour)
Step 37. Water the garden thoroughly for the first time (1 hour)
Step 38. Start seeds in indoor starter trays (2 weeks)
Step 39. Purchase an outdoor timer for the faucet (15 minutes)
Step 40. Read a book on companion planting (3 days)
Step 41. Consult a landscaping professional (2 hours)
Step 42. Check the long-term weather forecast (10 minutes)
Step 43. Calculate the total budget for supplies (2 hours)
Step 44. Purchase a sun hat and sunscreen (30 minutes)
Step 45. Join a local gardening club (1 hour)
Step 46. Evaluate the drainage capacity of the land (1 day)
Step 47. Choose a variety of vegetable species (2 hours)
Step 48. Buy a kneeling pad for comfort (15 minutes)
Step 49. Plant the main crop seeds (3 hours)
Step 50. Take photos of the empty space for reference (10 minutes)
Step 51. Rake the soil surface smooth (2 hours)
Step 52. Prune the first set of dead leaves (1 hour)
Step 53. Set up a composting bin (3 hours)
Step 54. Mow the lawn around the garden area (1 hour)
Step 55. Create a planting calendar (2 hours)
Step 56. Remove large tree roots (6 hours)
Step 57. Search for garden inspiration photos (2 hours)
Step 58. Check for underground utility lines (3 days)
Step 59. Install a motion-activated pest light (1 hour)
Step 60. Buy a bag of bone meal (30 minutes)
Step 61. Thin out the seedlings (2 hours)
Step 62. Subscribe to a gardening magazine (15 minutes)
Step 63. Sharpen the blades of the garden shears (45 minutes)
Step 64. Purchase a soil moisture meter (20 minutes)
Step 65. Buy a watering can for delicate plants (15 minutes)
Step 66. Clean all containers and pots (2 hours)
Step 67. Buy a pair of sturdy outdoor boots (1 hour)
Step 68. Draft a maintenance schedule (2 hours)
Step 69. Inspect the yard for sunlight patterns (1 day)
Step 70. Buy a notebook for a garden journal (15 minutes)
